notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food
description:
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that is a Food due to Ragost.
When the Treasure enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
Resolve the Food ability from step 1, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that is a Food due to Ragost.
When the Treasure enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
Repeat from step 5.
